target_statement: For any positive width-specific modulus mu(L) <= K for all L>=B, if a set S of ordinary positive integers is saturated at exact width L with respect to congruence mod mu(L), then it is saturated at those widths modulo K!. If it also contains a positive integer and is forward-closed under original decimal reverse-add, it contains a positive palindrome.
dependencies: Nat.dvd_factorial and reduction to a divisor
exact decimal Canonical semantics from original PR40
